messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Increased GPU prefill OOM rate in prod (cluster gpu-az3). Autoscaler flagged 18 container restarts in 6m. Paging on-call.

morgan: seeing the same in metrics — prefill failure spike at 22:57Z. spike correlated with large-context requests.

sanjay: jumping in. any customer impact yet?

eli: yes — SLO errors/rate of 503s up ~11% on inference-route /v1/chat for model-redwood-2x. A few large prompts from AcmeCorp and BoltAI.

morgan: logs from node gpu-az3-07: ```
[2026-03-14T22:56:49Z] runtime: prefilling seq_len=32768 tokens, batch=1
[2026-03-14T22:56:49Z] cuda: out of memory on GPU 0
[2026-03-14T22:56:49Z] Container exited with code 137 (OOM)
Stack: runtime::vm::alloc failed at kv_cache.cpp:412
```

peter: looks like long-context prefill allocs blow past reserved model memory and kernel fragmentation causes OOM. also seeing repeated prefill immediately after restart -> bounce.

morgan: confirmed container restart loop on pod inference-redwood-2x-7f8b. kube reports CrashLoopBackOff.

eli: quick mitigation idea: enforce prefill token cap and trim long prompt prefixes at the gateway for affected model version. Can flip a routing policy to a trimmed prefix policy.

sanjay: I can flip a temporary policy. Applying prefill_trim=8192 for model-redwood-2x@v12 in region us-west-2 now.

support-bot: record: change applied by sanjay at 22:59Z — prefill_trim=8192 (ephemeral).

morgan: while that's rolling, we should isolate noisy tenants. Any heavy requesters?

eli: filtering logs for top callers: AcmeCorp API key x-xxxxx produced 14 calls with >20000 token prefill in last 10m. BoltAI had 9 calls. Both sent multi-turn prompts.

peter: throttling or soft-failing oversized prefill requests might stop the rapid OOMs. we can set route-level reject_on_prefill_over=12000 for tenants with burst.

pagerduty: @oncall triggered: sanjay is primary, morgan is secondary. Severity: Sev2.

morgan: rolled an emergency config to disable aggressive prefetch on gpu-az3 pool (prefetch=false) — reduces prefill concurrency. monitoring for drop in OOMs.

eli: Rolling back prefetch seems to lower memory pressure. node gpu-az3-07 stabilized after one restart, no further crashes for that pod.

sanjay: policy update status: prefill_trim enforced across all API nodes in us-west-2 (approx 45 nodes). verifying request acceptance rate.

morgan: telemetry shows OOM error rate drop from 18/min -> 2/min in 10m window. good signal.

support-bot: customer impact assessment: ~3% of total customers experienced transient 5xx on chat endpoints between 22:55-23:05Z. Major customers affected: AcmeCorp (partial), BoltAI (partial).

eli: sent a targeted note to AcmeCorp SREs: "we observed large requests causing prefill OOMs; we applied temporary trimming and throttling; please limit prefill lengths to <12k tokens while we stabilize."

morgan: next steps: (1) apply short-term config (done), (2) schedule hotpatch to runtime allocator to better handle fragmented allocations, (3) add a prefill admission controller to reject very-large prefill before scheduling to GPU.

peter: I can open the runtime allocator hotpatch PR. estimate 2-3 days for safe rollout.

sanjay: I've created incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5489 (prefill-oom-gpu-az3). linking logs and policy change diffs.

eli: we should also consider a fallback to coldmodel (cpu) for oversized prefill rather than hard fail. that would avoid customer 5xx at cost of latency.

morgan: agreed. add to list.

kate: I'm taking handoff for midnight rotation (oncall). summary: prefill OOM spike in us-west-2 -> container restarts on gpu-az3; mitigation applied: prefill_trim=8192, prefetch=false, targeted throttling for noisy tenants. OOM rates reduced, customer impact limited to transient 5xx for ~10m. monitoring continues.

eli: added runbook checklist to ticket and pinned this thread. please include any follow-up regression tests for long-prompt workloads.

kate: I'll monitor for the next 2h and coordinate any rollback if we see regressions. handing over to @kate (oncall) at 23:10Z.

morgan: thanks team — great quick triage. leaving notes for postmortem: improve kernel allocation guard, implement admission controller, add tenant-level prefill quotas, and create a customer-facing post-incident summary template.

peter: quick proc command we ran for retrieval: ```bash
kubectl -n prod logs pod/inference-redwood-2x-7f8b -c runtime | grep -i "out of memory" -A4 -B2
```

support-bot: follow-up action items assigned in INC-5489.

kate: ping me on pager if anything spikes again. planning short write-up for impacted customers and schedule postmortem for tomorrow 14:00 PST. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-5489 created and linked to thread at 23:12Z. Notify: #statuspage, #oncall.

morgan: closing real-time loop here, leaving the channel for follow-up notes only.

kate: acknowledging handoff. will post updates in thread. :white_check_mark:
